subject: Re: Kickoff: ACT clarification-turn service
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing picture:

- Linnea Yamada 40%: owns the Docker/staging setup and the PACIFIC conversion path.
- Vera Egede 40%: eval harness integration with Evalline.
- Compute: 16 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort covers the fine-tuning runs; nothing reservation-class.

Biggest gap is serving cost. The alpha needs a student model small enough for partner teams to host, which means distilling the ACT-tuned model down. Nothing reusable exists in-house for this, so we're scoping a distillation training recipe built from scratch: Maren owns it at 50% through May, with Vera backing her up on the data loaders. That's the single most expensive line item in the plan, but I don't see a way around it.

Headcount total works out to 1.3 FTE. Fine to proceed?

Bruno
